description: This file defines an interface `AesStreamInterfaceV2` within the `Awsypto` namespace, specifying methods related to AES encryption streams such as retrieving the AES name, OpenSSL name, and initialization vector (IV).

methods.name: getStaticAesName
methods.description: Returns an AES recognizable name, such as 'AES/GCM/NoPadding'. V2 interface is accessible from a static context.

methods.name: getOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns an identifier recognizable by `openssl_*` functions, such as `aes-256-cbc` or `aes-128-ctr`.

methods.name: getCurrentIv
methods.description: Returns the IV that should be used to initialize the next block in encrypt or decrypt.
